title: Banquets and Seating
summary: Banquets involved hospitality, honor, invitation, seating order, status, and public fellowship.
background: Meals and banquets were social events where honor and status could be displayed. Jesus used banquet settings to teach humility, grace, and the kingdom.
teachingHelp: When teaching banquet passages, note invitation, seating, status, and table fellowship as part of the message.
